title: The action falls below the window
prompt: Create a landscape 16:9 diagnostic infographic, cream background charcoal outlines, large highly legible labels, restrained blue and burnt orange. Title 'P2 · The action falls below the window'. Left labelled CURRENT: schematic laptop browser frame with '1024 × 769' label. Within it vertical stack: toolbar 'Controls', rectangle 'Canvas · minimum 340px', expanded box 'Prompt'. Clearly draw browser bottom boundary as a thick dashed line, below it an outlined button labelled 'Generate' outside the visible window, arrow labelled 'Clipped'. Middle small mechanism 'Fixed canvas height + expanded prompt'. Right labelled PROPOSED: same browser frame same size, canvas somewhat shorter labelled 'Flexible canvas', prompt visible, Generate fully visible pinned within bottom boundary.
